package.package_checks: passed deterministic archive, license notices and invalid-input rejection

limitations: CRC checks detect accidental changes; they do not authenticate records.
The originating-record association is retained only in the current editing session, not across editor restart or external-command relaunch.
Legacy previous backups without fingerprints remain available for manual inspection and block automatic cleanup while present.
Tests use private local FAT images; concurrent writers, network-volume races and torn-sector writes are not qualified.
Recovery confirmation is keyboard-operated. Final command, display, mouse, constrained-memory and legacy-platform release qualification remains open.
The development package has not been promoted into the parent distribution.
